title: Laptop-held release coordinator: independent gate tools, pinned provenance verifier, forward-adoption permit and trust registry

criteria: local-release coordinate builds unsafe_measure and unsafe_ratchet from a previously released source (newest reachable v* tag by default), never the candidate, and holds them outside the repository
it admits only native provenance receipts at the candidate head that share one coordinator digest, use whole-workspace gates and are rooted as durable evidence
the provenance verifier is the held local-workflow executable whose digest equals every receipt's coordinator_sha256, and the policy digest comes from that executable
the permit names a forward-adoption baseline with historical_ownership incomplete and a git-rooted diagnostics blob listing unreceipted commits since the last promoted release
the pinned verifier must report verified=true before the permit and manifest enter the registry; registry objects are content-addressed and never overwritten
it prints SUSI_RELEASE_TRUST_REGISTRY, SUSI_RELEASE_GATE_TRUST and SUSI_RELEASE_GATE_TRUST_SHA256 for local-release qualify
the whole-workspace gate's foreground-seeding test releases the background copy only after the foreground run has announced it is waiting, instead of racing a fixed 3 s sleep on a loaded host
